verdict.rationale: The only DTMF-related evidence covers the assistant receiving keypad input from a caller. That is the inbound direction, not the agent sending keypresses. Nothing in the pack documents IVR navigation, voicemail detection, or leaving voicemail, so the applicable telephony axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
